sources.scope: 75 people; 92 option memberships, including 26 unrated placements

ratingSemantics.scope: All sacred-art user aesthetic ratings across previous and future review rounds

score0to2.rule: Immediately and permanently exclude from aesthetic gallery, re-review, shortlist, new candidate counts and final selections. Retain historical source/rating for audit only. New crop, resized source, file rename or photo is not a new work and cannot evade the rejection.

score3.rule: Insufficient; do not show for user re-rating or final selection. Use only internally to identify subject requiring further research, and source stronger distinct works. Preserve prior rating as evidence.

score4.rule: Present for the user's selection/confirmation review, even if another painting of the same subject has already been confirmed 5. Preserve 4 until explicitly changed; never automatically confirm, reject or suppress.

score5.rule: Automatically retain and select as aesthetically approved, no more aesthetic confirmation required. Technical identity, accurate depiction, reproducibility, licence and production checks remain separate.

nullRating.rule: Present only if a genuinely appropriate new candidate or previously proposed unscored painting and the source/image-quality gates pass; never infer approval.

ratingSemantics.categoryResearchRule: A subject/category with no qualifying subject-specific portrait scored 4 or 5 needs more paintings researched. A 4 removes the urgent research gap but is still awaiting user review; a 5 confirms a selection. Prior strong narrative scenes do not fulfill solo portrait coverage.
ratingSemantics.galleryRule: Display 4-rated works requiring the user's decision and eligible unrated new/prior proposals; 5-rated works in already-confirmed selected section. Never show 0-3 rated works as options again, not even greyed out, side-by-side or 'previously seen'.
ratingSemantics.originalIdentityRule: A rating belongs to the underlying original work. Copies, cropped photos, editions, and alternate files must not recreate rejected works as fresh candidates. Distinct physical originals only when their identifiers/provenance are established.
ratingSemantics.auditRule: Preserve all prior 0-5 data in non-UI historical ledger; do not delete or overwrite ratings to implement filter.
ratingSemantics.confirmedVsRights: 5 automatically means aesthetic selection, not automatic commercial-use rights or publication.

evidenceBoundary: The 75-person baseline is a later explicit ranking export than the Oct13 10:23 export; where exact artwork IDs differ, the later baseline score controls in the 75-person portrait workflow, but the original score and conflict are retained. 35 older unnumbered 'approved' artworks and 101 editorial subject selections are NOT silently converted to numeric 5s. Full original 277 scored file is not located; 197+50 explicit score rows directly present, plus membership linkage, is not proof of lifetime completeness.
